name: Docker
description: Multi-stage Dockerfile, docker-compose with peer services, dev override for hot reload, GitHub Actions image push

questions.prompt: Container registry? (the generated workflow targets ghcr.io; ecr/docker-hub require switching the commented login/env steps in docker-build.yml)
HTTP path for the container health check? (use / for any app, or /api/health if you also install the observability template)

validation.message: Must be a URL path starting with /, e.g. / or /api/health

checklist: Create .env.local (docker-compose reads it via env_file) — copy from .env.example
docker compose up --build   (dev mode + hot reload; merges docker-compose.override.yml automatically)
Enable backing services with profiles, e.g. COMPOSE_PROFILES=redis,postgres docker compose up — or persist COMPOSE_PROFILES in .env.local
Verify the app at http://localhost:3000/ — the container health check probes the health_path you chose (default /); point it at /api/health if you install the observability template
Production-equivalent run: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.ci.yml up --build
ghcr.io needs no extra secrets (uses GITHUB_TOKEN). For Docker Hub/ECR, set the REGISTRY_ORG repo variable and switch the commented login step in .github/workflows/docker-build.yml
